KS-32.8 fires only if the required confidence "cannot be achieved" — but the required confidence is never quantified, so an operator can always declare it achieved. That is precisely where it is wrong.

The paper never says how the two conditions compose (D > F *and* D > Threshold_eff? which binds?). Under the scaling rule alone, any node with D > 0 exceeds the threshold in a sufficiently fragile organism; under the floor rule, none does. The rule is incoherent exactly where it decides who dies.
